name: Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
definition: The **Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension** is $$\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\bydef\max_{S\subseteq\mathcal X}\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H_{|S}),$$ where $\mathrm{NCTD}$ is the no-clashing teaching dimension of the projected trace class.
graph_summary: Largest no-clashing teaching dimension attained by a coordinate projection.
description: The projection-monotonic closure of no-clashing teaching dimension. It is the quantity appearing in the stable-compression lower-bound theorem of the survey.
origin_references: Database-defined projection closure of the no-clashing teaching model of \cite{KSZ2019}.

monotonic.proof: If \(\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal H\), then \(\mathcal G_{|S}\subseteq\mathcal H_{|S}\) for every S. No-clashing teaching dimension is subfamily-monotonic, so maximizing its projected values preserves this inequality.

p_monotonic.proof: Every projection of \(\mathcal H_{|T}\) is also a projection of \(\mathcal H\), hence the maximum defining \(\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H_{|T})\) is at most that defining \(\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\).

c_monotonic.proof: Doubly monotonicity implies conditioning monotonicity, since a conditioned fibre is a subfamily followed by a projection.

doubly_monotonic.proof: The preceding direct arguments establish monotonicity under both subfamilies and projections.
